definitions.gloss: cover letter; transmittal slip; covering note
definitions.explanation: A brief document attached to materials being sent — such as faxes, documents, or packages — that identifies the sender, recipient, and contents. Standard in Japanese business communication.

examples.japanese: {送付状|そうふじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{添|そ}えて→添える：13315_soeru⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I send the documents with a cover letter attached.

examples.japanese: ファックス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{送付状|そうふじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{宛先|あてさき}→宛先：12275_atesaki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{枚数|まいすう}→枚数：13143_maisuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write the recipient and page count on the fax cover sheet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{職務経歴書|しょくむけいれきしょ}→職務経歴書：08724_shokumukeirekisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{送付状|そうふじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けて→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦{郵送|ゆうそう}→郵送：03176_yuusou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I mailed my resume and work history with a cover letter.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{送付|そうふ}→送付：07345_soufu⟧ (sending, forwarding) and ⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧ (document, letter). In Japanese business culture, including a {送付状|そうふじょう} with documents is considered basic etiquette, whether sending by mail, fax, or even email attachment.

The typical format includes the date, recipient name and company, sender name and contact information, a greeting, a list of enclosed items, and a closing. Templates are widely available and follow a standard layout.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {送付状|そうふじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{添|そ}える→添える：13315_soeru⟧: to attach a cover letter
- {送付状|そうふじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧: to prepare a cover letter
- ファックス{送付状|そうふじょう}: fax cover sheet
- {送付状|そうふじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テンプレート→テンプレート：11493_tenpureeto⟧: cover letter template

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {添|そ}え{状|じょう}: accompanying letter — synonym, slightly more traditional
- ⟦カバー→カバー：07812_kabaa⟧レター: cover letter — loanword, used more in foreign-company contexts
- {挨拶状|あいさつじょう}: greeting letter — for seasonal or formal greetings, not document transmittal
